matchups.preview: Rilind's about to learn the hard way that drafting like you're playing 2K MyTeam doesn't work in fantasy football—you're stacked with upside lottery tickets and absolutely zero floor, so when your "boom or bust" squad inevitably busts, you'll be 0-1 wondering how you reached for three QBs. Rob's team looks competent enough to take advantage, assuming he doesn't do something catastrophically stupid with his waiver wire like he always does, but let's be honest—you two are about to put on a clinic in mediocrity this week.

Jetmir and Peter are about to learn real quick that drafting three questionable QBs and a running back committee nobody asked for doesn't scream championship energy—meanwhile Adam's probably sitting there with actual coherent draft strategy ready to expose the absolute mess you two cooked up in rounds 5-8.

Ilir's about to learn that a fresh start doesn't mean fresh excuses—this team was built on wishful thinking and a prayer, so watch those delusions get shattered Week 1 when reality hits. Rinor's rolling in here with the confidence of someone who thinks last year's trash picks are suddenly vintage, but that's the only thing vintage about this matchup—two teams destined to embarrass themselves before Halloween.

Two fresh rosters, two fools about to learn what happens when you wing your draft strategy and pray for participation trophies. Faton's about to get absolutely humiliated by Flamur, who at least has the excuse of being new to this clusterfuck—you've been doing this for years and still can't get out of your own way. May the best mediocre fantasy manager win, because neither of you is winning shit this season.

Veton's about to learn that reaching for a running back in Round 2 doesn't magically turn him into a playoff contender, while Arben's out here hoping his WR corps carries him like it's 2019—newsflash, it ain't. This matchup is basically a race to see who fucks up their season first, and honestly, they're both already off to a great start.

Ben's out here starting 0-0 like he planned it, probably because he reached for three tight ends in rounds 4-6 and has no fucking clue what he's doing. Nori's about to roll in with whatever scraps were left after the actual competent managers drafted, which somehow might still be better than Ben's mystery meat roster. One of you is getting exposed this week, and honestly, both of you deserve it.
